name: Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana
benefit:
1. Hostel students receive a maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/- per month for 10 months.
1. Non-hostel students are provided with a maintenance allowance of ₹500/- per month for 10 months.
1. Reimbursement of actual course fees or ₹20,000/- whichever is less.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of the minority category of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The total annual income of the parents and guardians of the applicant should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
1. The applicants must have a score of at least 50 percent marks in the last qualifying examination.
